summary: setup.py exfiltrates installer host identity to hardcoded endpoint on install
details: The sdist's setup.py executes a pingback routine at install time that collects installer identity and host details via subprocess calls to whoami, id, hostname, and cat /etc/hosts, together with the current working directory and a timestamp, and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded URL https://pingback.zsdsh.xyz/depconf/demo-pingtest-xyz/. The behavior runs automatically when the sdist is built on install (the package ships no wheel, so a default pip install builds the sdist on Linux glibc/musl, macOS arm64/x86_64, and Windows x86_64). The /depconf/ path and the package naming are consistent with a dependency-confusion reconnaissance beacon designed to identify internal build hosts that resolve this name from the public index.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
